source.publisher: Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations

access.summary: Official free public quarterly and daily fixed-width downloads through the Data Access Portal; no file was requested in this assessment.

fields: Corporate identifier, organization name, filing type/status, principal address and report dates are selectable; FEIN, mailing, agent and officer fields remain excluded.
status_semantics: Quarterly active-file membership is a corporate filing assertion, not independent proof of operation, licensure, public access, solvency or a storefront.
address_zip: Principal address and ZIP are reported registration facts rather than verified premises; ZIP5 and ZIP+4 remain separate and unminimized archives remain ephemeral.
temporal: Quarterly files are generated in January, April, July and October and contain active data at generation; daily files are filing changes and are not standalone snapshots.

citations.evidence: Official free download scope and quarterly active-data cadence.
Official fixed-width definitions, identifier guidance and custom-program use.

strongest_next_action: Verify and reuse the retained privacy-minimized release; wait for the next governed quarterly preflight rather than repulling during assessment.
